title: b1bc.4: Add dkim_signer field to NntpQueue struct
description:
What: Modify NntpQueue in crates/smtp/src/queue.rs to hold an optional shared DkimSigner.

Algorithm:
1. Add field: dkim_signer: Option<Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner>> to the NntpQueue struct.
2. Add parameter dkim_signer: Option<Arc<mail_auth::dkim::DkimSigner>> to NntpQueue::new().
3. Store it: Self { ..., dkim_signer }.
4. start_drain() already passes self (or Arc<Self>) to spawn — no change to start_drain signature needed, drain_once will read self.dkim_signer.
5. update any existing test constructors (e.g. NntpQueue::new(queue_dir.path())) to pass None as dkim_signer.

Defensive programming:
- dkim_signer is Arc-wrapped: no Clone of the key material, just reference counting.
- drain_once will use the field in b1bc.6; this bead only adds the field/constructor param.

Tests: Existing tests must still pass after adding None for dkim_signer.
